tools.name: robot_create
tools.title: Create Robot
tools.description: Creates a persistent robot with a unique name for the authenticated owner.

tools.name: robot_list
tools.title: List Robots
tools.description: Lists robots owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: robot_delete
tools.title: Delete Robot
tools.description: Deletes a stopped robot and its persistent home.

tools.name: openDesktopForRobot
tools.title: Open Desktop for Robot
tools.description: Starts or reuses the robot desktop without ALA so its persistent coding-agent home can be configured; cwd is optional and defaults to the robot workspace.

tools.name: startDesktopTaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Desktop Task for Robot
tools.description: Starts or reuses the desktop and asynchronously runs ALA through its computer-use MCP bridge.

tools.name: stopDesktopTaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Desktop Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops ALA but preserves the live desktop.

tools.name: startBrowserTaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Browser Task for Robot
tools.description: Starts or reuses the lighter browser container and asynchronously runs ALA through its browser MCP bridge.

tools.name: stopBrowserTaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Browser Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops ALA but preserves the live browser.

tools.name: startSimpleALATaskForRobot
tools.title: Start Simple ALA Task for Robot
tools.description: Asynchronously starts ALA without a GUI container.

tools.name: stopSimpleALATaskForRobot
tools.title: Stop Simple ALA Task for Robot
tools.description: Stops the active simple ALA task.

tools.name: getTaskStatusForRobot
tools.title: Get Task Status for Robot
tools.description: Returns the active or most recent task status.

tools.name: getSessionUrlForRobotDesktop
tools.title: Get Desktop Session URL
tools.description: Returns the authenticated live desktop URL.

tools.name: getSessionUrlForRobotBrowser
tools.title: Get Browser Session URL
tools.description: Returns the authenticated live browser URL.

tools.name: stopDesktopContainerForRobot
tools.title: Stop Desktop Container
tools.description: Stops and removes the desktop and its MCP bridge.

tools.name: stopBrowserContainerForRobot
tools.title: Stop Browser Container
tools.description: Stops and removes the browser and its MCP bridge.
